def transform(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    line=max(g[i].count(4)==w for i in range(h)), any(all(g[i][j]==4 for i in range(h)) for j in range(w))

    # find minority color
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r in g for v in r if v!=sep)
    minor=cnt.most_common()[-1][0]
    rr=[i for i in range(h) if not all(x==sep for x in g[i])]
    cc=[j for j in range(w) if not all(g[i][j]==sep for i in range(h))]

    return [[1 if sum(1 for i in rg[a] for j in cg[b] if g[i][j]==minor)==2 else sep for b in range(len(cg))] for a in range(len(rg))]
